📐 GARMENT ENGINEERING & CONSUMPTION ENGINE

Technical Style Costing & Multi-Fabric Matrix

Separates Net Garment Weight (g), Gross Fabric Consumption (g/kg with process wastage), and Extended Fabric Cost (₹) across sizes S–XXXL. Missing inputs are strictly distinguished from zero order quantities.

Documented Costing Calculation Formulas, Units & Validation Rules

1 m² = 10,000 cm² · 1 kg = 1,000 g
1. Component Net Weight (g)

For each enabled component c and size s ∈ {S..XXXL}:
Area(m²) = [(L + Seam) × (W + Seam) × Panels] / 10,000
NetWeight(g) = Area(m²) × FabricGSM

2. Gross Fabric Consumption (kg)

Kept strictly separate from Net Garment Weight by incorporating process wastage w%:
Consumption(g) = NetWeight(g) × (1 + w/100)
Consumption(kg) = Consumption(g) / 1,000

3. Cost & Missing-Input Guardrails

ComponentCost(₹) = Consumption(kg) × PricePerKg.
A size quantity of 0 is a valid zero order for that size; blank/missing measurements or unassigned fabrics raise explicit validation errors.
